For in-person client meetings in India, I’d compare these three:

Option	Approx. cost	What to check
Plaud Note	₹16,990	1,200 min/month Pro plan; 7-day returns and 1-year warranty. Check India support, replacement shipping and subscription renewal. 
Plaud
+1

Notta Memo	~₹20,000–22,000	Hardware + transcription subscription. Free plan is only 120 min/month; paid plans have recording limits. Cancellation generally needs 24h notice; unused time isn't refundable. 
Notta
+1

Limitless Pendant	Check India landed price	Free tier includes 1,200 min/month and no subscription is required. Check India availability, import duties, warranty and return shipping. 
Limitless Help Center
+1

For client meetings, also check: Hindi/Indian-accent accuracy, speaker separation, offline recording, data storage/location, export to CRM, battery life, and whether recording requires informing participants.
